dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline on the trailing edge, exhibiting significant inward curvature from the sub-apex region down to the basal transition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's maximum vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steeply angled convex anterior margin, approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the horizontal base axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: 1.42:1 ratio of maximum base pixel width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant V-shaped notch located at the base of the trailing edge; secondary minor indentations along the posterior margin above the primary notch; mottled skin texture on the lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Deep, angular basal notch on the trailing edge is a highly diagnostic unique identifier.
